title: Branch Softside Mid Century Modern Office Chair | Removable Arms with Luxury Cloud-Like Comfort, Adjustable Height, Integrated Lumbar Support, Boucle Fabric, Oatmeal
features: CLOUD-LIKE COMFORT: Sink into our all-new comfortable office chair made with a plush hybrid cushion that combines 2” foam with nested inner coils for unparalleled comfort. It offers all the benefits of an aesthetic desk chair while bringing complete support to your workspace. Enhance your office with a luxury office chair at an attainable price, offering the perfect blend of sophistication and supreme comfort.

ERGONOMIC DESIGN: This ergonomic office chair features integrated lumbar support and adjustable height, tilt, and tilt lock to ensure ideal posture and support. The Softside Chair’s lumbar support enhances your comfort while working long hours at your desk. Combining modern functionality with classic style, this mid-century office chair is perfect for any workspace.

FABRIC OPTIONS: Choose from high-quality fabric including vegan leather, velvet or boucle to match your style and needs. Our leather desk chair options offer a sophisticated look and a soft feel, while vegan leather provides a sustainable alternative. Experience a plush seating experience with any of these materials, ensuring a soft desk chair for comfort throughout your workday.

DURABLE & RELIABLE: This styled vintage desk chair meets BIFMA standards for commercial-grade use, supporting up to 275 lbs, making it perfect for home or office environments. Your new aesthetic office chair combines durability with a mid-century modern desk chair design.

CUSTOMIZABLE FEATURES: The wide desk chair seat accommodates various seated postures, offering exceptional comfort. Removable armrests transform it into an armless office chair, perfect for a sleek and contemporary look in any workspace. Enhance your office with this modern retro desk chair, blending timeless design with customizable comfort.
